"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

    basecolour[:,:,c]=v-(y-100)*.42+(x-125)*.012
noise=rng.normal(0,.30,(H,W))
basecolour+=noise[...,None]
# Keep a little of the lighting gradient on the glossy platform.
basecolour+=2.0*np.exp(-((x-159)/8)**2)[...,None]
basealpha=base_region.copy()
basealpha*=1-np.clip(front+back,0,1)
clean=clean*(1-basealpha[...,None])+basecolour*basealpha[...,None]
# Erase the old balls and their hanging wires from the photographic plate.
anchors_front=[87.0,104.0,121.2,139.0,156.2]
anchors_back=[96.6,110.0,123.4,136.7,150.3]
initial_x=[85.2,98.3,126.5,139.3,152.0]
oldpaths=[]
for k,bx in enumerate(initial_x):
    oldpaths.append([(anchors_front[k],19.5),(bx,92.1)])
    oldpaths.append([(anchors_back[k],12),(bx,92.1)])
wiremask=line_mask(oldpaths,2.4)
wiremask[y<20]=0
wiremask*=1-np.clip(front+back,0,1)
# cover the isolated portions of the initial spheres above the rear edge
bm=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8)
for bx in initial_x: cv2.ellipse(bm,(round(bx),96),(8,8),0,0,360,255,-1)
remove=np.maximum(wiremask*255,bm.astype(float)*(1-base_region))
remove*=1-np.clip(front+back,0,1)
clean=cv2.inpaint(np.clip(clean,0,255).astype(np.uint8),(remove>55).astype(np.uint8)*255,3,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
# Image-based chrome sphere templates, softly antialiased, no synthetic balls.
# The center and right-hand balls contain the original scene reflections.
sprites=[]
for bx,by in [(126.2,96.8),(139.0,96.8),(152.0,96.8)]:
    n=18*S
    gy,gx=np.mgrid[:n,:n]; dx=(gx+.5)/S-9; dy=(gy+.5)/S-9
    mpX=(bx+dx).astype(np.float32);mpY=(by+dy).astype(np.float32)
    rgb=cv2.remap(I,mpX,mpY,cv2.INTER_CUBIC,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)
    radial=np.sqrt((dx/6.15)**2+(dy/6.0)**2)
    alpha=np.clip((1.075-radial)*7,0,1)
    # small metal eyelet joining the two fine threads
    neck=np.clip(1-np.abs(dx)/1.7,0,1)*np.clip((dy+9)/1.2,0,1)*np.clip((-dy-4.9)/1.2,0,1)
    alpha=np.maximum(alpha,neck)
    rgba=np.dstack((rgb,(alpha*255).astype(np.uint8)))
    sprites.append(Image.fromarray(rgba))

# reflected balls: extract the scene's subdued, blurred reflection, rather
# than placing an unnaturally bright mirror image on the black base.
reflections=[]
for bx in [126.3,138.5,151.6]:
    n=22*S; gy,gx=np.mgrid[:n,:n]; dx=(gx+.5)/S-11;dy=(gy+.5)/S-11
    rgb=cv2.remap(I,(bx+dx).astype(np.float32),(119.6+dy).astype(np.float32),cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
    alpha=np.exp(-((dx/6.7)**4+(dy/7.0)**4))
    alpha*=np.clip((8.0-dy)/2,0,1)
    reflections.append(Image.fromarray(np.dstack([rgb,(alpha*205).astype(np.uint8)])))

C=Image.fromarray(clean).resize((W*S,H*S),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).convert('RGBA')
# Repair a short piece of the rear chrome support hidden behind the clamp.
d=ImageDraw.Draw(C)
for off,col,wd in [(0,(26,29,27,255),2.2),(-.5,(137,138,125,255),.65),(.6,(77,72,49,255),.6)]:
    d.line([(int((86+off)*S),int(78*S)),(int((87.8+off)*S),int(94*S))],fill=col,width=max(1,int(wd*S)))

# Immutable photographic front posts cover the moving suspended objects.
fg=I.copy(); fgmask=np.clip(front+back,0,1)
fgmask[y<20]=1
fg_img=Image.fromarray(np.dstack([fg,(fgmask*255).astype(np.uint8)])).resize((W*S,H*S),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)
tool_img=Image.fromarray(np.dstack([I,(tool*255).astype(np.uint8)])).resize((W*S,H*S),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)

# A Newton cradle transfers the two-ball impulse from one end to the other.
# The end-pairs follow pendulum arcs and stop upon their return to contact.
rest=np.array([100.7,113.5,126.3,139.1,151.9])
length=80.3
amplitude=math.asin(15.5/length)
omega=2*math.pi/1.22

def state(t):
    q=-amplitude*math.exp(-.043*t)*math.cos(omega*t)
    a=np.zeros(5)
    if q<0: a[:2]=q
    else: a[3:]=q
    px=rest+length*np.sin(a)
    py=96.8-length*(1-np.cos(a))
    # Central mass stays almost at rest, as momentum travels through contact.
    return px,py,a

def paste_center(canvas,img,px,py):
    canvas.alpha_composite(img,(int(round(px*S-img.width/2)),int(round(py*S-img.height/2))))

def render(t):
    canvas=C.copy()
    px,py,ang=state(t)
    # matching low-contrast reflections move with the masses
    for k in range(5):
        ry=119.6+(96.8-py[k])*.64
        paste_center(canvas,reflections[k%3],px[k]-.15,ry)
    # after letting go, the blue/black grabber withdraws to the left
    shift=105*(min(max(t,0)/.62,1)**.82)
    dy=2*min(t/.62,1)
    if shift<92:
        canvas.alpha_composite(tool_img,(int(-shift*S),int(dy*S)))
    # thread rasterization at four times the output resolution preserves the
    # slender translucent gray nylon suspension wires.
    ropes=Image.new('RGBA',canvas.size)
    rd=ImageDraw.Draw(ropes)
    for k in range(5):
        target=(px[k],py[k]-5.35)
        for ax,ay,opacity,wd in [(anchors_back[k],9.5,72,.34),(anchors_front[k],17.3,105,.41)]:
            rd.line([(round(ax*S),round(ay*S)),(round(target[0]*S),round(target[1]*S))],fill=(175,171,153,opacity),width=max(1,round(wd*S)))
            rd.line([(round((ax+.22)*S),round(ay*S)),(round((target[0]+.22)*S),round(target[1]*S))],fill=(231,224,198,38),width=1)
    canvas=Image.alpha_composite(canvas,ropes)
    for k in range(5):
        paste_center(canvas,sprites[k%3],px[k],py[k])
    canvas=Image.alpha_composite(canvas,fg_img)
    return np.array(canvas.convert('RGB').resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))

frames=[I.copy()]
for k in range(1,20):
    t=k/4
    # brief exposure blur, evaluated analytically in real time
    out=np.mean([render(t+v) for v in [-.009,0,.009]],axis=0)
    frames.append(np.uint8(np.clip(out,0,255)))
frames=np.stack(frames)
save(frames,ROOT)
Image.fromarray(clean).save(ROOT/'.tmp/clean.png')
